title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for VLA Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.11498v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models require 3D spatial reasoning, yet RGB observations encode robot-object geometry only implicitly. Lifting depth with camera intrinsics makes this geometry explicit as dense, image-aligned pointmaps, but their camera-frame coordinates depend on camera placement. We propose SeeR-VLA, which transforms pointmaps into a robot-centric frame with an end-effector origin and robot-base-aligned axes. An encoder initialized from pretrained RGB weights extracts pointmap features, which are added to corresponding RGB tokens without increasing the token count. Across 24 RoboCasa tasks and four real-world tasks, SeeR-VLA improves average success over RGB-only $\pi_{0.5}$ by 6.4 and 32.5 percentage points, respectively. It also exceeds the strongest evaluated 3D-augmented baseline, PointVLA, by 3.5 and 23.7 percentage points, respectively. Beyond these gains, our ablations clarify how coordinate choices affec

translated_title: 像机器人一样看：面向VLA模型的以机器人为中心的点图
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要3D空间推理能力，然而RGB观测只能隐式地编码机器人与物体之间的几何关系。利用相机内参将深度提升为稠密的、与图像对齐的点图可以使这种几何关系显式化，但其相机坐标系下的坐标依赖于相机的摆放位置。我们提出了SeeR-VLA，该方法将点图转换到以机器人为中心的坐标系中，该坐标系以末端执行器为原点，坐标轴与机器人基座对齐。一个由预训练RGB权重初始化的编码器提取点图特征，并将其添加到相应的RGB token中，且不增加token数量。在24个RoboCasa任务和4个真实世界任务上，SeeR-VLA相比仅使用RGB的π0.5分别将平均成功率提升了6.4和32.5个百分点，并分别以3.5和23.7个百分点的优势超过了所评估的最强3D增强基线PointVLA。此外，消融实验阐明了坐标系选择对性能的影响。
tldr: SeeR-VLA通过将点图转换到以末端执行器为原点、与机器人基座对齐的机器人中心坐标系，并将点图特征融合进RGB token中，显著提升了VLA模型在仿真和真实任务上的操作成功率。
en_tdlr: SeeR-VLA transforms pointmaps into a robot-centric frame with an end-effector origin and robot-base-aligned axes, fusing pointmap features into RGB tokens to significantly improve VLA manipulation success rates in both simulation and real-world tasks.
